<details class="computational-graph-text-alternative">
<summary>Text alternative</summary>

<ul>
<li><strong>Teacher forcing</strong>: Conditioning strategy in which the prefixes supplied at scored positions come from the reference sequence.</li>
<li><strong>Observed-prefix context</strong>: Observed prefixes built from reference tokens; at each position, only the prefix preceding its target is supplied, and predictions are computed in parallel under a causal mask.</li>
<li><strong>Token-ID context</strong>: Ordered sequence of IDs conditioning the next prediction.</li>
<li><strong>Model parameters</strong>: Learned weights used by the forward pass; they remain fixed during inference, scoring, and evaluation, and change only through training updates.</li>
<li><strong>Model forward pass</strong>: Applies the model computation to the current context to produce logits at each position.</li>
<li><strong>Logits</strong>: Unnormalized vocabulary scores computed at each position.</li>
<li><strong>Vocabulary softmax</strong>: Converts one position&#x27;s logits into a conditional distribution over the next token.</li>
<li><strong>Next-token conditional distribution</strong>: The pθ(· | context) distribution shared by generation and observed-target scoring.</li>
<li><strong>Observed target</strong>: Known token in the reference sequence, used for scoring, evaluation, or training.</li>
<li><strong>Target-probability extraction</strong>: Extracts from the distribution the probability corresponding to the observed target-token ID.</li>
<li><strong>Target probability</strong>: Probability assigned to the target token at the position being scored.</li>
<li><strong>Target log-probability computation</strong>: Applies the logarithm to the observed target probability; a numerically stable implementation may compute log-softmax directly from logits.</li>
<li><strong>Target log-probability</strong>: Logarithm of the conditional probability assigned to the observed target token.</li>
<li><strong>Negative target log-probability</strong>: Negates the log-probability to obtain the per-token loss.</li>
<li><strong>Sequence log-likelihood</strong>: Sum of conditional log probabilities for observed tokens under the scoring protocol.</li>
<li><strong>Per-token NLL</strong>: Negative logarithm of the probability assigned to the observed target.</li>
<li><strong>Evaluation metrics</strong>: Measures computed from scores on held-out data, without parameter updates; in language modeling, these include NLL and perplexity.</li>
</ul>

<ol>
<li><strong>Teacher forcing</strong> — conditions → <strong>Observed-prefix context</strong></li>
<li><strong>Observed-prefix context</strong> — conditions → <strong>Token-ID context</strong></li>
<li><strong>Token-ID context</strong> — is consumed by → <strong>Model forward pass</strong></li>
<li><strong>Model parameters</strong> — is consumed by → <strong>Model forward pass</strong></li>
<li><strong>Model forward pass</strong> — produces → <strong>Logits</strong></li>
<li><strong>Logits</strong> — is consumed by → <strong>Vocabulary softmax</strong></li>
<li><strong>Vocabulary softmax</strong> — produces → <strong>Next-token conditional distribution</strong></li>
<li><strong>Next-token conditional distribution</strong> — provides the score for → <strong>Target-probability extraction</strong></li>
<li><strong>Observed target</strong> — conditions → <strong>Target-probability extraction</strong></li>
<li><strong>Target-probability extraction</strong> — produces → <strong>Target probability</strong></li>
<li><strong>Target probability</strong> — is consumed by → <strong>Target log-probability computation</strong></li>
<li><strong>Target log-probability computation</strong> — produces → <strong>Target log-probability</strong></li>
<li><strong>Target log-probability</strong> — is aggregated into → <strong>Sequence log-likelihood</strong></li>
<li><strong>Target log-probability</strong> — is consumed by → <strong>Negative target log-probability</strong></li>
<li><strong>Negative target log-probability</strong> — produces → <strong>Per-token NLL</strong></li>
<li><strong>Sequence log-likelihood</strong> — is aggregated into → <strong>Evaluation metrics</strong></li>
<li><strong>Per-token NLL</strong> — is aggregated into → <strong>Evaluation metrics</strong></li>
</ol>
